business_question_en: If Google were its own first customer, should thermal-materials money go to discovering new high-conductivity materials or to putting known ones on chips?
business_question_zh: 如果 Google 自己是第一个客户，散热材料的钱该花在发现新的高导热材料上，还是把已知材料装上芯片？

business_question_en: How far is a material predicted to have high ionic conductivity from a battery maker being willing to test it?
business_question_zh: 一个预测具有高离子电导率的材料，距离电池厂愿意测试还有多远？

business_question_en: AI generates huge numbers of crystal structures; which are worth paying to validate?
business_question_zh: AI 生成了大量晶体结构，哪些值得花钱验证？
decision_en: Approve small controls; defer large compute
decision_zh: 批准补对照的小额算力；暂缓大规模算力

business_question_en: Market layer only: demand for manufacturable HTS tape (fusion is a downstream buyer).

business_question_zh: 只在市场层：TORAX × CFS 作为软件合作的先例。
